non_blocking_findings.finding: P4-003 import modes have JVM/build/lint evidence, but no device smoke yet for selecting append/overwrite/new-space modes, typing overwrite confirmation, or validating result screens.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Keep NATIVE-P4-007 as the device evidence gate for import, export, wipe, first-launch prompt, and logcat checks.

non_blocking_findings.finding: New-space mode is implemented as a stable source-derived imported space to satisfy idempotency. It intentionally does not create unlimited duplicate spaces on every rerun.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: If the product later needs an explicit duplicate-copy mode, add it as a separate mode instead of weakening current idempotency.

non_blocking_findings.finding: P4-004 now has data-backed current-session and full-backup export foundations, but Android share/save delivery and Settings export actions are not implemented.
non_blocking_findings.recommendation: Finish P4-004 delivery surfaces before running P4-007 validation or claiming LEG-031 progress beyond in_progress.
